tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed pa nges pa'i don gyi 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba nyung ngu rnam gsal dag cing tshang ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed pa nges pa'i don gyi 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba nyung ngu rnam gsal dag cing tshang ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed pa nges pa'i don gyi 'jug

ngogs zhes bya ba nyung ngu rnam gsal dag cing tshang ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ skabs kyi dgongs don la/ theg pa chen po la tshul rnam pa gnyis las/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung lugs/ rje btsun byams pa dang*/ 'phags pa thogs med sku mched/ phyogs glang chos grags sogs rnam rig smra ba'i gzhung lugs rnams kyi grub mtha'/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel sogs bka' 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde rnams kyi dgongs don dang*/ dbu ma ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i gzhung lugs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rigs tshogs rnams kyi dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas bskyangs legs ldan zla grags pa la sogs pa rnams kyi bzhed pa bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan gyi rim pa gnyis las/ bod 'dir dbu ma rang stong du yongs su grags pa'i dbu ma ngo bo nyid med pa'i gzhung lugs 'dzin pa rnams ni/ lugs snga ma de la sems tsam lugs dang*/ phyi ma la dbu ma'i lugs zhes gsungs sh-ing*/ gzhan stong smra bar yongs su grags pa 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo nges don mthar thug tu bzhed pa rnams ni/ lugs phyi ma de spyir dbu ma'i grub mtha' yin yang*/ dbu ma la gnas skabs pa'i nges don dang mthar thug gi nges don gnyis yod pa las/ de gnas skabs pa'i nges don yin zhing*/ lugs srol snga ma de la gnas skabs kyi grub mtha' gzhan dbang bden grub tu 'dod pa dang*/ gzhan yang rnam pa bden par smra ba'i lugs kyi grub mtha' rnams ni sems tsam yin la/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bden par med cing*/ yongs grub gnyis med kyi ye shes bden grub tu ston pa'i grub mtha' bod gzhan dag sems tsam rnam brdzun zhes zer ba 'di ni nges don mthar thug gi dbu ma chen po yin no zhes brjod do/ /des na rang stong smra ba rnams ni/ bka' 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor ni drang don dang*/

bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor ni nges don mthar thug /tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gnas skabs kyi nges don te drangs don yin par bzhed la/ gzhan stong smra ba rnams ni dang po drang don dang*/ bar ba gnas skabs kyi nges don/ tha ma mthar thug gi nges don ston par bzhed/ de yang 'khor lo dang po nyan thos dang thun mong gi sde snod yin pas kun rdzob kyi chos rnams yod par gsungs la/ bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo rnams su ni/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos ma grub cing yod pa'i chos rdul tsam yang med par bshad/ tha ma nas ni 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs ngo don dam bden pa dbyings rig dbyer med ni/ ngo bo gdod ma nas 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ rtag brtan ther zug pa 'di ni bden par yod la/ dngos med rnams dang*/ gzugs sogs yul mig sogs dbang po sems sems byung ste/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig la sogs pa gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa rnams ni/ don dam de'i rnam 'gyur tsam me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gdod nas ma skyes pas bden med du gsungs/ des na mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa la 'khor lo dang po dang*/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa la bar pa dang*/ theg pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa la tha ma gsungs bar bshad cing*/ dang po dang bar pa gnyis bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pa dang*/ tha ma ni bla na ma mchis pa/ skabs ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don rtsod pa'i gzhi ma yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor lo bar par chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa ni/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum la ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum sbyor ba la dgongs nas de ltar gsungs kyi/ don dam du yod pa'i chos gtan nas mi srid pa la dgongs pa ni ma yin pa dang*/

len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes/ /'di ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan/ /zhes 'khor lo dang por thams cad yod par gsungs pa'i rjes thog nyid du don dam bden grub 'di yod par gsungs na/ sems can rnams la thog ma nyid nas bdag tu lta ba'i bag chags yod pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rkyen gyis gang zag gi bdag tu rtog par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod pas/ 'khor lo bar par zag med kyi dbyings 'di yod ces ma gsungs par/ chos thams cad ma grub pa ltar gsungs pa yin pa'i tshul zhib rgyas su gsungs so/ /de la rang stong pa rnams ni spyir 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dang*/ khyad par mdo 'di nyid kyang drang don yin zhing*/ de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang bar pa gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs 'ba' zhig la gsungs par snang bas nges don dang*/ tha ma theg pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa'i bsam pa tha dad pa mang po 'dul ba'i phyir bstan pas drang don yin par yang grub la/ rigs pas kyang 'thad de dper na gcig du bral gyi rigs pas bum pa lta bu zhig bden med du gtan la 'bebs nus na/ rigs pa des gnyis med kyi ye shes kyang bden med du gtan la 'bebs nus te/ bden pa'i gcig dang du mar ma grub pa sogs dpyad pa thams cad mtshungs par 'jug pa'i phyir bden med du grub la/ gzhan yang rnam rdzun gyi grub mtha' de dbu ma yin na/ sems tsam pa'i mdo sde dang bstan bcos med par 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon yod gsung ngo*/ /gzhan stong smra ba rnams ni/ 'khor lo rim pa gsum po 'di yang dus thog mtha' ni ma yin te/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo phal po che'i le'u shas che ba zhig bden bzhi'i chos 'khor ma bskor ba'i sngon rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas ma thag tu lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi gnas su gsungs pa yang yod la/

mdo sde myang 'das lta bu mya ngan las 'da' khar gsungs pa yang yod/ de bzhin du mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo la sogs pa 'khor lo dang po'i mdo la la mya ngan las 'da' khar gsungs pa yang yod pas so/ /des na 'di ni brjod bya'i don gyi go rim mam/ gdul bya'i rgyud sbyong tshul gyi rim pa gsum yin pas de lta bu'i rim pa tha ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo tha ma nges don du grub ste/ brjod bya'i don gyi mthar thug drang don yin pa mi rung zhing*/ gdul bya nges don la khrid zin pa'i 'og tu slar yang drang don la khrid pa mi rung ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo bar pa theg chen la zhugs zhes gsungs pa yang theg chen gyi theg pa'i rim pa mang po la/ blo ma sbyangs pa'i gang zag dbang po shin tu smin pa ma yin pa rnams la gsungs pas mthar thug gi nges don ma yin zhing*/ 'khor lo tha ma gsungs pa'i yul theg pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ la la nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa/ la la rang rgyal la zhugs pa/ la la theg chen la zhugs pa/ la la dbang po rno/ la la dbang po rtul zhes bya ba'i don ma yin te/ de ltar yin na bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung ste/ /zhes gsungs pa yang mi 'grig ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ba theg chen la gsar du 'jug pa'i skabs zag med kyi dbyings 'di yod par gsung na bdag tu lta ba 'byung ba'i gnas srid pa dang*/ de ltar yod pas re zhig zab mo'i don de ma bstan par chos thams cad bden med du gsungs par bshad pas/ 'khor lo bar pas blo sbyangs zin pa'i gang zag la lam 'di ston rgyu yin pa'i phyir sngar theg chen la ma zhugs pa dang*/ 'khor lo bar pas rgyud sbyangs pa gnyis 'gal bas so/ /des na theg pa mtha' dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i don theg pa mtha' dag la zhugs pas rgyud sbyangs zin pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang rnon gdul bya shin tu smin pa rnams la gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir 'di nyid nges don du grub la/

yang rnam pa gcig tu rang stong pa rnams kyi lugs de ltar na/ 'khor lo dang po dang 'khor lo tha ma gnyis mthun pa shas che dgos pa las 'dir ni de ltar med par 'khor lo bar pa dang po dang mthun shas che zhing*/ 'khor lo tha ma theg dman dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir 'di nyid mthar thug yin la/ de ltar yin pa ni mngon sum gyis grub ste/ 'khor lo dang po gnyis char du snang ba sems su ma gsungs pa dang*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad ma bshad pa dang*/ chos lnga dang rang bzhin gsum sogs kyi rnam bzhag kyang dang po nas gtan nas ma bshad cing*/ bar pa nas kyang rgyas par ma byung ba dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes 'di lta bu 'khor lo de gnyis char nas ma bshad cing nyan thos rnams de lta bu gtan nas med par 'dod la/ dbu ma rang stong pa rnams kyang skabs 'dir nyan thos sde gnyis dang mthun par khas blangs pa'i/ chos thams cad bden med du 'dod mi 'dod tsam ma gtogs grub mtha' la khyad chen po ma zhugs shing*/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa theg pa che chung gi 'dod pa thams cad la yod par 'dod pa ltar na/ nyan thos sde gnyis dang rang bzhin med rtogs kyi lta ba'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs/ theg pa gsum bsgom bya'i lam gcig par 'dod pa sogs phal cher mthun zhing*/ des na spyod pa'i khyad par ma gtogs/ lta ba'i sgo nas nyan thos dang theg chen yang nyams len gcig par don gyis khas blangs pa yin no/ /'khor lo tha ma ni 'khor lo dang po dang shin tu khyad che ste/ snang ba sems su gsungs pa dang*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang chos lnga rang bzhin gsum sogs rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ nyan thos rnams yod par 'dod pa'i phyi don 'dir gtan nas med par gsungs shing*/ nyan thos rnams gtan nas mi 'dod pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes bden grub tu gsungs la/ nyan rang dang theg chen gnyis la lta ba'i khyad par shin tu che bar gsung bas so/

/de'i phyir rang stong pa rnams kyi lugs ltar na/ nyan thos kyi mdo rnams nges don shas che zhing*/ sher phyin tsam ma gtogs theg chen gyi mdo sde 'byams klas pa rnams drang don 'ba' zhig yin no zhes theg pa che chung la drang nges go log tu 'gyur ro/ /gzhan stong 'di bka' tha mar ma zad/ bar pa'i yang dgongs pa yin pa par sher phyin gyi byams zhus kyi le'ur/ mtshan nyid gsum khas blangs phyin/ chos thams cad bden med du khyad par med par 'dod na/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag byas pa dgos med du 'gyur ba dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las kyang*/ ji skad bshad bzhin don min bcom ldan dgongs pa shin tu zab/ /ces pa'ang sher phyin gyi mdo tshig gis dngos bstan tsam mthar thug gi nges don du bzung rgyu min pa'i don du snang bas/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos rnams kyi steng gi kun brtags dang gzhan dbang gnyis bden med du gsungs nas/ yongs grub la re zhig btang snyoms su mdzad pa yin no/ /dbu sems gnyis la mdo sde tha dad du med par ni 'dod de/ mdo sde gcig la dgongs pa 'grel lugs kyi khyad par tsam yin pas 'di la mi 'thad pa med de/ bye mdo gnyis la yang mdo sde tha dad med kyang dgongs pa len lugs kyi khyad par tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir sems tsam rnam bden pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mang du byung phyin chad na/ bstan bcos kyi po ti yod med la ma reg cing*/ glegs bam yod kyang bod du 'gyur ni mi dgos te/ dgos na nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad kyi nang nas gos dmar sde ba ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams kyi sde snod gsum dang mdo sde ba'i gzhung lugs kyang med par 'gyur te bod na mi 'dug pa'i phyir zhes par mi 'gyur ram/ des na tshad ma rnam 'grel spyir mdo sde ba'i bstan bcos ma yin zhing*/ yin du chug kyang chos skad zar zur tsam las grub mtha' rdzogs par med pa dang*/

mdo sde ba'i lta ba'i rnam gzhag tsam byung bas de yod par 'gyur na/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung thams cad du rnam bden gyi lta ba'i rnam gzhag byung bas sems tsam gyi gzhung yang yod par ci'i phyir mi 'gyur/ gzhan yang 'khor lo bar pa nges don dang*/ tha ma drang don du bstan pa'i mdo'i lung yang med cing*/ dgongs 'grel du bar pa drang don dang tha ma nges don du gsungs pas drang nges so sor phye zhing*/ drang don dgongs pa can du bkral bas mdo sde 'di nyid kyang dgongs pa can du 'grel dgos na ha cang thal ba dang*/ rang phyogs la drang nges dgongs pa can du phye ba'i mdo'i lung med bzhin du/ gzhan lugs kyi lung dgongs pa can yin no zhes zer ba dbang che ba'i spyod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir dang*/ klu sgrub kyi rig tshogs su rang stong gsungs kyang*/ bstod tshogs su gzhan stong gsungs pa'-i phyir phyogs gnyis char la rjes su 'gro zhing*/ gzhan legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa la sogs pa rnams spyir paṇ+ḍi ta mchog yin yang*/ rgyan drug gi nang du tshud pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi bstan pa 'dzin par lung bstan pa thob pa'i/ thogs med sku mched phyogs glang chos grags dang do brdo ba'i yul ma yin zhing*/ khyad par 'phags pa thogs med ni mdo sde drang nges 'byed par sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan la/ dbyig gnyen 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu thugs la bzhugs pa dang*/ dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos skyong rnams la/ zla ba grags pa dang ye shes snying po sogs kyis kyang rang las mkhas shing gsan rgya che ba dang*/ shing rta chen po yin par dag pa byin pa'i phyir/ zla grags sogs kyi lung la brten te thogs med sku mched 'gog pa ni gzu lum yin no zhes gsung ngo*/ /gzhan yang grub mtha'i steng nas phyogs 'di gnyis la dgag sgrub shin tu mang bar 'dug na'ang ye ge mangs par 'gyur zhing*/ re zhig gzigs mi bde bar snang bas ma bris lags la/

de la rang stong gi don ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong zhing bden par med pa'i phyir chos thams cad rang stong yin zhes 'dod pa'i don yin la/ gzhan stong ni kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad bden med rang gi ngo bos stong pas rang stong yin yang*/ don dam gyi dbyings ni bden par grub pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos mi stong la/ 'on kyang stong nyid ni yin te gzhan gzung 'dzin sogs spros pa thams cad kyis stong pa'i phyir don dam ni gzhan stong yin no/ /zhes bzhed pa'i don yin pas kun rdzob rang stong yin pa la mthun yang*/ don dam rang stong du bzhed mi bzhed kyi khyad par yin no/ /kun rdzob dang don dam yang 'jog lugs mi 'dra ste/ rang stong pa rnams ni 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di ltar snang ba ni kun rdzob yin la/ de rnams rang bzhin med pa gang yin pa de ni don dam bden par 'jog ste/ don dam de yang spros pa thams cad dang bral tsam la 'jog /gzhan stong ba rnams ni dngos po dngos med gzung 'dzin sogs gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni kun rdzob yin la/ don dam pa'i dbyings gnyis stong gi ye shes rang rig pa ni don dam du 'jog pas/ don dam spros pa dang bral tsam la mi 'jog par gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi spros pas dben pa'i rig pa la 'jog /spros pa dang bral tsam nam mkha' lta bu ni bem stong dang chad stong yin par 'dod/ des na rang stong pa rnams kyi don dam med dgag dang dngos med la 'jog /gzhan stong pa rnams kyi don dam dngos po yin pa rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du 'dus byas pa ma yin pa/ snga phyi thams cad 'gyur ba med la rtag brtan g.yung drung yin pa'i phyir chad mthar mi 'gyur/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir rtag pa'i mthar mi 'gyur ba tshig gis brjod pa'i yul las 'das shing*/ rnam rtog gis 'di lta bu'o zhes bzhag tu med pas rtog ge'i yul las 'das pa dang*/

so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi myong bya yin par bzhed do/ /des na mtshan nyid gsum ka la las gzhan dbang ni 'khrul snang can gyi shes pa yin la/ kun brtags de la snang ba'i 'khrul ba yin zhing*/ yongs grub ni shes pa de gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi 'khrul bas stong zhing rang rig gi ngo bos mi stong pa 'di yin pas/ kun brtags brda' dang tha snyad kyis bzhag pa tsam ma gtogs gtan nas med pa dang*/ gzhan dbang kun rdzob tu yod don dam du med pa dang*/ yongs grub don dam du yod pa ste/ kun brtags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ gzhan dbang skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ yongs grub gzung 'dzin gyi ngo bor med pas don dam ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /des na rang stong ltar na chos de dang de'i ngo bo nyid med pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du 'dod mod kyang*/ kun rdzob kyi chos de dang de'i ngos nas stong nyid du mi 'jog ste/ dper na bum pa rang bzhin med pa'i cha nas bum pa stong pa nyid yin par yang 'dod mod/ kun rdzob bum pa rang gi cha de stong nyid du mi 'dod de/ bden gnyis gcig tu 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon yod pas so/ /gzhan stong ba rnams ni stong nyid la don dam bden pa'i ma khyab ste kun brtag ni med pa'i stong nyid dang*/ gzhan dbang ni yod pa'i stong nyid dang*/ yongs grub ni rang bzhin stong nyid du bzhed pas gzhi grub na stong nyid yin pa'i khyab pa 'cha' ba yin no/ /des na rang stong pa rnams ni gzhi grub na stong nyid kyi khyab mtha' mi 'cha' zhing*/ stong nyid don dam gcig pa dang rang stong nyid yin na spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings tsam po yin pas khyab par 'dod/ gzhan stong pa rnams de las zlog pa yin te/ don dam stong nyid kyi gtso bo shes rig gi cha nas 'jog /don dam gyi dbyings de ni gcig du bral la sogs pa rigs pa'i lam las 'das pa/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams dang mi 'dra bas rigs pa des gnod pa med de/

kun rdzob kyi chos dngos med rnams ni ngo bos med cing*/ dngos po rnams ni dus dang phyogs kyis bsdus pa yin pas rigs pa de 'jug la/ gnyis med kyi ye shes de ni phyogs dus kyi ma bsdus pas rigs pa de mi 'jug ste/ ye shes de la skad cig mang por dbye pa dang*/ skad cig de'i thog mtha' bar gsum dpyod pa sogs ni ye shes de dus las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la dus gsum gang yang med pas de'i skad cig sogs shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir/ rig pa de'i rtsa ba stong pa yin la/ de bzhin du don dam de rten 'brel du yang mi bzhed do/ /des na shes pa la rnam shes dang ye shes/ rig pa la rang rig dang gzhan rig /stong pa la rang stong dang gzhan stong*/ chos la chos can dang chos nyid sogs zhib mor phye nas snang ba thams cad sems su 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs sku gdul bya gzhan snang gis bsdus kyi sangs rgyas ma yin par bzhed pa dang*/ sems spros bral sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin par ma zad/ sems kyi gsal ba ma 'gags pa la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dbyer med kyi ngo bos gnas pas sems can gyi rgyud la/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs yon tan drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan dbyer med kyi tshul gyis yod/ mngon gyur gsar thob kyi sgo nas yod par mi 'dod pas spyir sems can tsam sangs rgyas su thal ba'i skyon med/ sems can gyi chos nyid sangs rgyas yin pa dang*/ chos nyid de spros bral gyis khyad par du byas pa'i gsal cha ma 'gags pa la bzhed 'dir zag med kyi sems rgyun mdo nas bshad pas kyang grub/ sems can dang sangs rgyas gnyis ka sems kyi rgyun la 'jog /bem shes gnyis tshogs pa ma yin te/ dngos gnas la bem shes gnyis tshogs pa dang de 'dra mi srid pa sogs kyis phyir ro/ /des na de dag la sogs pa ni gzhan stong gi grub mtha'i mthil yin zhing*/

sdug kun lam bden gsum po kun rdzob 'dus byas bden med/ 'gog bden don dam 'dus ma byas pa bden grub sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi lam bden gyi ming can/ 'gog bden dang dbyer med yin pas don dam 'dus ma byas yin la/ de 'dra'i 'gog bden de yang stong pa nam mkha' lta bu la mi 'jog par rang rig chen po yin pas sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin 'gog bden dang*/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rang bzhin lam bden/ 'gog lam spangs rtogs ngo bo dbyer med ces kyang gsung ngo*/ /kho bo phyogs su lhung ba ma lags te/ 'di dag nges pa'i don la ni shin tu 'byor bar sems lags/ dbu ma ngo bo nyid med pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma 'di nges don la lhag par 'byor par sems shing*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa'ang gzhan stong gsal ba dang*/ rang stong gis kyang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma 'di'i phyogs su lhan pa kho na mthong ngo*/ /rang stong gzhan stong gi khyad par gsal la go bde ba zhig ye ger bris gsung ba re zhig de tsam mo/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas phul ba'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla chen byams pa ngag dbang gis bskul ba yin/ dge'o/ /gcig zhus dag /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed pa nges pa'i don gyi 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 194 -- PAGE 195 -- PAGE 183 -
